GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2013-04-11T19:24:28Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Pass all $.ajax options for fetch, save, and destroy
Description: It seems like success and error callbacks are the only options passed to $.ajax. What is the benefit of this? I'm finding it very hard to add a custom header to a single API call because the only thing that has worked so far is $.ajaxSetup, but then the custom header is added to every subsequent API call. Is there an easier way to add a custom header for a single ajax call?
